tldr_zh: Gemini和ChatGPT先後突破10億用戶，OpenAI測試ChatGPT廣告，NVIDIA發布Nemotron模型。
tldr_en: Gemini and ChatGPT both reach 1B users; OpenAI tests ads in ChatGPT; NVIDIA launches Nemotron models.

items.title_zh: Google Gemini達10億月活用戶，成Google增長最快產品
items.title_en: Google Gemini reaches 1 billion monthly active users, fastest-growing Google product
items.summary_zh: Google執行長Sundar Pichai宣布Gemini達到10億月活躍用戶里程碑，成為Google有史以來增長最快的產品。Gemini每日生成超過1.5億張圖片，其中63%用戶使用語音功能與助手交互，展示AI助手的廣泛應用前景。
items.summary_en: Google CEO Sundar Pichai announced Gemini reached 1 billion monthly active users, marking Google's fastest-growing product ever. The AI generates over 150 million images daily, with 63% of users utilizing voice features, showcasing strong adoption across diverse use cases.

items.title_zh: ChatGPT用戶數突破10億，與Gemini並列AI應用里程碑
items.title_en: ChatGPT surpasses 1 billion users, matching Gemini's milestone
items.summary_zh: OpenAI的ChatGPT用戶數同步突破10億大關，與Google Gemini並列成為首批達成此里程碑的AI應用。兩大AI助手的快速成長反映出生成式AI技術已進入主流應用階段，形成激烈競爭。
items.summary_en: OpenAI's ChatGPT reached 1 billion users, joining Gemini as the first AI applications to achieve this milestone. The rapid adoption of both platforms reflects generative AI's transition into mainstream use, intensifying competition in the AI assistant market.

items.title_zh: OpenAI測試ChatGPT廣告功能，保護用戶隱私並確保回答獨立性
items.title_en: OpenAI tests ads in ChatGPT with privacy protections and answer independence
items.summary_zh: OpenAI開始在ChatGPT測試廣告以支持免費使用。廣告將清晰標註，不影響回答品質，並提供強隱私保護及用戶控制選項，旨在平衡商業可持續性與用戶體驗。
items.summary_en: OpenAI begins testing ads in ChatGPT to support free access with clear labeling and strong privacy protections. The company emphasizes that advertisements will not affect answer quality or independence, offering users full control over their experience.

items.title_zh: NVIDIA發布Nemotron 3.5 Lightning模型與NeMo Switchyard框架
items.title_en: NVIDIA launches Nemotron 3.5 Lightning and NeMo Switchyard framework
items.summary_zh: NVIDIA推出Nemotron 3.5 Lightning輕量級模型和NeMo Switchyard框架，為企業提供高效能的LLM部署解決方案。該系列模型在RTX和DGX硬體上優化，支持快速推理和邊緣部署。
items.summary_en: NVIDIA introduced Nemotron 3.5 Lightning models and NeMo Switchyard framework for efficient LLM deployment. Optimized for RTX and DGX hardware, these solutions enable fast inference and edge deployment capabilities for enterprises.

items.title_zh: 騰訊發布WorldClaw 3D世界生成模型，實現大規模開放場景生成
items.title_en: Tencent releases WorldClaw for large-scale 3D open-world generation
items.summary_zh: 騰訊公開WorldClaw（Hunyuan3D）3D世界生成模型，能以Agentic方式進行大規模開放世界場景生成。該技術在遊戲、影視製作等領域具重要應用潛力。
items.summary_en: Tencent unveiled WorldClaw (Hunyuan3D) for agentic 3D open-world generation at scale. The model demonstrates significant potential for gaming and film production applications with autonomous world-building capabilities.

items.title_zh: Claude新增AI生成內容標記，文字浮水印和C2PA中繼資料
items.title_en: Anthropic adds AI content credentials to Claude with watermarks and C2PA metadata
items.summary_zh: Anthropic規劃Claude在8月2日歐盟推出新模型時加入AI生成內容標記。文字含不可見浮水印，圖像檔案附帶C2PA數位簽署的來源資訊，用於追蹤內容來源與真實性。
items.summary_en: Anthropic plans to add AI-generated content credentials to Claude starting August 2 in the EU. Text will include invisible watermarks while image files carry C2PA-compliant signed metadata, enabling content provenance tracking globally.

items.title_zh: OpenAI特殊項目主管Brad Lightcap離職，8年任期結束
items.title_en: OpenAI executive Brad Lightcap departs after 8-year tenure
items.summary_zh: OpenAI特殊項目主管及前任COO Brad Lightcap宣布離職，結束其在該公司8年的任期。Lightcap表示將開啟新的事業方向，但未披露詳細計畫。
items.summary_en: OpenAI's Brad Lightcap, former COO and special projects lead, announced his departure after eight years. While Lightcap mentioned exploring new horizons, specific details about his next venture remain undisclosed.

items.title_zh: Meta無法阻止州政府1.4兆美元訴訟進入審判階段
items.title_en: Meta cannot block states' $1.4 trillion lawsuit from proceeding to trial
items.summary_zh: 法院裁定第230條款提供防守權但非訴訟豁免權，Meta無法阻止多州提起的1.4兆美元訴訟進入審判。此案涉及Meta平台對兒童造成的傷害賠償責任。
items.summary_en: Courts ruled that Section 230 provides a defense but not immunity, allowing a $1.4 trillion multi-state lawsuit against Meta to proceed to trial. The case centers on alleged harms to children from Meta's platforms.

items.title_zh: Chrome推出裝置綁定工作階段認證，防止帳號接管攻擊
items.title_en: Chrome deploys device-bound session credentials to prevent account takeovers
items.summary_zh: Google Chrome採用裝置綁定工作階段認證技術，可有效防止日益普遍的帳號接管攻擊。此機制將認證與特定裝置綁定，大幅降低駭客成功劫持帳號的風險。
items.summary_en: Google Chrome adopts device-bound session credentials as a defense against increasingly common account takeover attacks. The mechanism binds authentication to specific devices, significantly reducing the success rate of account hijacking.

items.title_zh: Atlassian AI助理Rovo爆發RovoBlast點擊漏洞，攻擊無需提示
items.title_en: Atlassian's AI assistant Rovo vulnerable to RovoBlast click-based exploit
items.summary_zh: 資安公司Varonis揭露Atlassian AI助理Rovo的RovoBlast漏洞，攻擊者可通過誘導用戶點擊惡意連結竊取應用資料，攻擊過程無需提示或授權確認。Atlassian已於7月完成修正。
items.summary_en: Varonis disclosed the RovoBlast vulnerability in Atlassian's Rovo AI assistant, allowing attackers to steal app data through malicious links without user warnings. Atlassian patched the flaw in July.

items.title_zh: 美澳日英法等40國聯合聲明，呼籲導彈試射提前24小時通報
items.title_en: 40 nations including US, Australia, Japan call for 24-hour advance missile test notifications
items.summary_zh: 美國與澳洲、加拿大、法國等40國發布聯合聲明，呼籲發射洲際彈道飛彈及潛射彈道飛彈的國家應至少提前24小時通報。此舉回應中國7月潛射洲際飛彈試射引發的國際關切。
items.summary_en: The US, Australia, Japan, France and 37 other nations issued a joint statement calling for nations to provide at least 24 hours' advance notice before testing ballistic and submarine-launched missiles. The move follows China's July submarine-launched ballistic missile test.

items.title_zh: 哥倫比亞強震致180人喪生，歐盟出動衛星系統救援
items.title_en: Colombia earthquake kills 180, EU deploys satellites for relief efforts
items.summary_zh: 哥倫比亞遭遇強震災情慘重，死亡人數達180人。歐盟執委會向哥倫比亞提供援助，通過衛星系統等手段協助救援工作。
items.summary_en: Colombia was hit by a devastating earthquake with 180 deaths confirmed. The EU Commission expressed condolences and is assisting relief operations through satellite systems and other support measures.
